title: Conversation
description: A conversation record, intended as the base for a conversation lookup (reference) dataset. Keyed by conversation identifier; descriptive fields such as the topic hierarchy are supplied by field groups (for example fieldgroups/agentic/conversation).

xdm:conversationID.title: Conversation ID
xdm:conversationID.description: Unique identifier for the conversation. Serves as the primary identifier for the lookup and the key that conversation data joins against.
